title: Joint large sieve for the incomplete Kloosterman numerator

resource_policy.literature_policy: Audit primary spectral-large-sieve, incomplete-Kloosterman, bilinear Kloosterman-fraction, and delta/Kuznetsov theorems before import.

frozen_target.question: Can the exact conductor-scale incomplete-numerator Kloosterman family be bounded strongly enough to prove the J^(1/2) fixed-centre product-wavelet estimate, or does a diagonal, axial, or theorem-hypothesis obstruction isolate a smaller survivor?
frozen_target.reference_formula: For J=X^(1/2), Q=X^(1/5), T=J/Q, and T<=C<=J, normalize S_C=sum_(c asymp C) sum_(b<<c/T,(b,c)=1) sum_(rho,sigma) alpha_(c,b)(rho,sigma;X) e_c(+-bN+lambda_c rho sigma bbar), including even-modulus variants and axial modes, and prove an aggregate saving T/J^(1/2)=X^(1/20).
quantities: all actual weights, local factors, gcds, axial modes, and dual lengths retained

completion_criteria: Derive the exact dyadic formula and every prefactor from the accepted finite delta representative.
State a normalized joint inequality and prove that it is sufficient after all sums.
Prove it, give an actual-symbol counterexample, or isolate a strictly narrower obstruction.
Audit axial modes, gcds, even moduli, completion frequencies, and primary-source hypotheses.
Complete clean blind and hostile/source gates.
Do not promote a full cone or exponent from a fixed-interior estimate.

tasks.target: Derive the exact dyadic conductor contribution and prove the X^(1/20) aggregate saving by dispersion, reciprocity, completion-after-averaging, or a genuinely joint large sieve; otherwise prove a sharp capacity no-go and isolate the first new inequality.

Independently derive the weakest sufficient dyadic large-sieve statement from the frozen packet, test every power and diagonal, and prove it or give a rigorous packet-level no-go without inventing missing weights.
excluded_context: all source cards and web literature

tasks.target: Reconstruct the normalized family, search for diagonal, axial, gcd, and resonance obstructions, and audit exact applicability of primary spectral-large-sieve, incomplete-Kloosterman, bilinear-fraction, and Kuznetsov theorems.

dual lengths, diagonal, axial modes, and gcds

closing_decision: Promote the exact order-J Farey stationary bound through C=J^(2/3) and the scoped upper-conductor B-process self-return; retain the upper conductor, full wavelet, M9-M1, and exponent open.
